anchor.statement: Proposition A.4. There are finite choices in the order (A.6) for which the profile specified in Section A.2 defines smooth U, E for X > 0, η ∈ [−1, 1], with E > 0, and satisfies (A.8). All stage boundaries divided by X R are independent of X R and η . After the compact axial pulse, U = M = J = 0; after the terminal interval, E = E pow . correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: Split into the profile with its smoothness, E > 0, moment identities (A.8), U = M = J = 0 after the pulse and E = Epow after the terminal interval; the relaxed cone from log x− ≤ 0 through tail coordinate 1/2 and the admissible cone from the hold start for large XR (extended back to where l < 0 by the third declaration); and the four disjoint reserved patches with U = 0 and E a positive multiple of f X^(−1/2−λ). The independence of stage boundaries from XR and η holds by construction (boundaries are fixed logarithmic times, XR enters only through log(X/XR)).
